articles.title: 1989년 당시 보도: 힐즈버러 참사 뒤 리버풀의 슬픔과 분노

events.title: 리버풀 play Scottish champions 셀틱 in the last Dubai Champions Cup , an unofficial "British Championship". John Aldridge scores for 리버풀 to equalise a Mark McGhee goal for 셀틱, and the game finishes 1–1. 리버풀 lose 4–2 on penalty kicks.
뉴포트 카운티 lose a final appeal against their closure in the High Court more than a month ago; they are expelled from the GM Vauxhall Conference and their record for the season is expunged.
노팅엄 포리스트 win the League Cup with a 3–1 win over holders 루턴 타운 in the final at Wembley.
월솔 announce the sale of Fellows Park , their home since 1903, and will relocate to a new stadium at Bescot from the start of the 1990–91 season.
힐즈버러 참사 — 리버풀과 노팅엄 포리스트의 FA컵 준결승이 열린 힐즈버러에서 관중 압사 사고가 발생했다. 당일의 주장과 이후 조사에서 확인된 사실을 분리해 봐야 한다.

English football endures its greatest ever tragedy with the death of 94 리버풀 supporters, and injury of some 300 others, at the FA Cup semi-final clash with 노팅엄 포리스트 at Hillsborough . Some of the injured are in a serious condition and there are fears that the death toll could rise even higher. The match is abandoned, while the other semi-final sees 에버턴 beat 노리치 시티 1–0 at Villa Park .
Hillsborough disaster , that occurred at Hillsborough , before the FA Cup Semi-Final between 리버풀 & 노팅엄 포리스트.

Within 48 hours of the tragedy at Hillsborough, Home Secretary Douglas Hurd promises to pass new legislation which will force all Football League teams to remove standing accommodation from their stadiums. The Football Association gives the go-ahead for the FA Cup to continue, with the re-staged match to take place at Old Trafford on 7 May, despite calls for the final not to be played.

The Hillsborough disaster death toll reaches 95 when 14-year-old Lee Nicol dies in hospital from his injuries. Many more of the injured are still in hospital, and there are fears that six spectators who had to be resuscitated have suffered brain damage.

The Sun newspaper posts a front-page article about the Hillsborough disaster, headlined "The Truth", with lurid and untrue allegations about 리버풀 fans' conduct, from sources including South Yorkshire Police and Conservative MP Irvine Patnick . The claims were later disproved by the Hillsborough inquest, and caused an ongoing boycott of The Sun in 리버풀.

Of the 25 리버풀 fans who were extradited in connection with the Heysel disaster of May 1985, in which 39 spectators died at the European Cup final , 14 are found guilty of voluntary manslaughter; they went on to serve one year in prison.

아스널 remain top of the league as April draws to a close, but are now just three points ahead of a 리버풀 side who have superior goal difference and a game in hand. 노리치 시티 are now eight points behind the leaders. At the other end of the table 웨스트햄 유나이티드 are ten points from safety, and occupy the relegation zone with 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 and 루턴 타운. 첼시 have sealed an immediate return to the First Division as Second Division champions, while 맨체스터 시티 are just five points away from returning as runners-up after a two-year exile. 왓퍼드 and 크리스털 팰리스 are now the only other teams who can go up automatically, while 블랙번 로버스 and 스윈던 타운 complete the top six. 노팅엄 포리스트 beat 에버턴 4–3 in the Full Members Cup final at Wembley to become the first club in English football to win two domestic cups in the same season. 리버풀 travelled to Glasgow to play their first game since the Hillsborough disaster. 60,000 attend at Parkhead to watch them beat 셀틱 4–0 in a match arranged to raise money for the disaster fund. An estimated £500,000 is raised.
